_readme: TEMPLATE. Do not edit by hand -- run configure.ps1, which detects the local paths and renders preset.json. Placeholder fields are substituted at render time.

flac3d.projectDirNote: Default working directory for new FLAC3D instances. Set with configure.ps1 -ProjectDir.

bridge.pairing: The bridge speaks either WebSocket (0.2.x) or HTTP+SSE (0.5.x). flac-mcp 0.5.2 only speaks HTTP+SSE, so a 0.2.x bridge fails with a bare '400 Bad Request'. Keep bridge >= 0.5.

mcpServer.transportNote: stdio lets the MCP client own the server lifecycle (recommended). 'http' runs it as a standalone service usable by several clients at once.

dsh.note: Only used by apply_dsh_mcp.ps1. Everything except the DSH integration works without DSH.
